prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D SpriteKit desktop pet sprite atlas for PawSync.
Generate a high-quality ORIGINAL cozy desktop typing companion, in a charming flat hand-illustrated sticker style: organic rounded contours, warm dark-brown smooth outlines of consistent weight, solid muted colors, minimal soft cel shading, affectionate simple face. Cute like an indie desktop pet; not 3D, not realistic, not geometric clip art. Subject: Cream tabby cat with cinnamon stripes, triangular ears, tiny brown dot eyes, pink nose, soft blush cheeks, a warm ivory muzzle and belly.
The image MUST be a transparent-background 1536x1024 PNG sprite atlas arranged in EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows (each cell 512x512), with six completely separated cutouts centered in the respective cells, ample transparent padding and NO overlap across cells:
TOP LEFT: the complete detached HEAD ONLY, including ears and face; neck edge clean and rounded. No body or paws.
TOP CENTER: detached plump pear-shaped TORSO ONLY with chest/belly markings, no head, no arms, no paws, no feet. An uncomplicated rounded shoulder/neck edge for attaching the head.
TOP RIGHT: a detached LEFT FOREPAW, short soft arm with rounded mitten tip, paw pointing down; no shoulder/body.
BOTTOM LEFT: matching detached RIGHT FOREPAW, mirrored, paw pointing down.
BOTTOM CENTER: detached TAIL ONLY, base at left and tail extending right (the bunny/bear/panda may have a small rounded tail).
BOTTOM RIGHT: a fully assembled bust of the SAME pet, front-facing, leaning over a compact cream retro keyboard with two rounded paws resting on it. This cell is a preview thumbnail. Only head, shoulders, chest and forepaws are visible: no standing legs or human anatomy.
The five detached parts must be IDENTICAL in design to those in the assembled preview; consistent outline thickness/color. Do not put labels, cell lines, text, watermark, decorations, checkerboard pattern or background anywhere. The space between cutouts must be truly transparent alpha. Keep every part strictly inside its assigned cell. Attractive and legible when reduced to a 180-pixel desktop companion.
